description: The Chief's tool to see, make and edit other Chiefs (hq .cmux-scratch/hqec-slack/CHIEF-TOOLS.md). The brain (optchat-chief) offers it to a Chief's own turn only when the Chief's record holds the `chiefs` tool, never to a subagent, and answers each call on its own bound daemon connection (principal = the Chief's id) with chief.profile.list, chief.profile.get, chief.profile.create, chief.profile.update, chief.profile.avatar.set, chief.profile.history and chief.profile.undo. The daemon enforces the rules (a new or edited Chief gets only what the calling Chief holds; no Chief deletes a Chief; the default Chief's tools, harnesses and self_edit are the person's; a locked Chief refuses every Chief); this text only tells the model. The brain reads this file at build time, so the turn's tool list stays byte-identical while the file does not change.

tool.name: chiefs
tool.description: See, make and edit the person's other Chiefs. action list returns every Chief; get returns one (chief: its id or name). create makes a new Chief (display_name required; role, personality, instructions; the tools, harnesses, self_edit, harness, model and effort you omit are taken from your own grant). update changes another Chief (chief plus the fields to change: name, role, personality, instructions, picture, and its backend: harness, model, effort). history lists a Chief's kept versions (rev, when, who); undo restores the version before its last change, or to_rev. avatar_path is a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP file on this machine, at most 1 MiB, that becomes that Chief's picture; clear_avatar true removes it. You can give a Chief only tools, harnesses and self_edit that you hold yourself and a harness you may use, you cannot edit a Chief that holds more than you or one the person locked, you cannot change the default Chief's grant, and you cannot delete a Chief (the person does). Change yourself with the profile tool. After a create, the answer says whether the new Chief's brain started; tell the person exactly that, and never say it answers when its brain did not start.

chief.description: The Chief's id (agent_...) or its name; for get, update, history and undo.

harness.description: The engine harness: any acpmux harness id the caller may use, e.g. claude, codex, claude-sr2, opencode, unii (UniiChat: the person's uniichat.com chat, signed in with `unii login` on this Mac), or the person's own (cmux harness add).

answers.list: The records as chief.profile.list returns them, as JSON text.
answers.changed: The record after the create or update, as JSON text; after a create, its brain (started, or not_started with the reason) and one line that says it plainly.
answers.not_the_turn: 'chiefs: only this Chief's own turn may use it.' (a subagent, or a caller without the turn's key)
